title.zh: 卷四 本紀第四: 熙宗
title.raw: 卷四 本紀第四: 熙宗 Volume 4 Annals 4: Xizong

sentences.zh: 熙宗弘基纘武莊靖孝成皇帝，諱亶，本諱合剌，太祖孫，景宣皇帝子。

translations.literal: Emperor Xizong, posthumous title Hongji Zuowu Zhuangjing Xiaocheng, taboo name Dan, original taboo name Hela, grandson of Taizu, son of Emperor Jingxuan.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xizong—posthumously styled Broad Foundation, Continuing Martial Prowess, Solemn and Tranquil, Filial and Accomplished—was taboo-named Dan, born Hela, a grandson of Taizu and son of Emperor Jingxuan.

sentences.zh: 母蒲察氏。

translations.literal: His mother was of the Pucha clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother belonged to the Pucha clan.

sentences.zh: 天輔三年己亥歲生。

translations.literal: He was born in the third year of Tianfu, the year jihai.
translations.idiomatic: He was born in the third year of Tianfu (the jihai year).

sentences.zh: 天會八年，諳班勃極烈杲薨，太宗意久未決。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tianhui, the an-ban boji lie Gao died, and Taizong’s mind had long been unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tianhui the an-ban boji lie Gao died, and Taizong had still not settled on a successor.

sentences.zh: 十年，左副元帥宗翰、右副元帥宗輔、左監軍完顏希尹入朝，與宗幹議曰：「諳班勃極烈虛位已久，今不早定，恐授非其人。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Left Deputy Commander-in-Chief Zonghan, Right Deputy Commander-in-Chief Zongfu, and Left Army Supervisor Wanyan Xiyin entered court and discussed with Zonggan, saying: “The an-ban boji lie post has stood vacant too long; if we do not decide soon, we may invest the wrong man.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Zonghan as left deputy commander-in-chief, Zongfu as right deputy commander-in-chief, and Wanyan Xiyin as left army supervisor came to court and urged Zonggan: “The heir’s seat has been empty too long. Delay now and we may set the wrong man upon it.

sentences.zh: 合剌，先帝嫡孫，當立。

translations.literal: Hela is the late emperor’s legitimate grandson; he should be installed.”
translations.idiomatic: Hela is the late sovereign’s legitimate grandson—he is the one to install.”

sentences.zh: 」相與請于太宗者再三，乃從之。

translations.literal: Together they petitioned Taizong again and again, and he at last assented.
translations.idiomatic: They pressed Taizong again and again until he finally agreed.

sentences.zh: 四月庚午，詔曰：「爾爲太祖之嫡孫，故命爾爲諳班勃極烈，其無自謂沖幼，狎于童戲，惟敬厥德。

translations.literal: On gengwu in the fourth month, an edict said: “You are Taizu’s legitimate grandson; therefore I appoint you an-ban boji lie. Do not fancy yourself young and treat it as child’s play; only honor your virtue.”
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the fourth month an edict ran: “You are Taizu’s legitimate grandson, and I therefore name you an-ban boji lie. Do not plead youth and turn the office into a game—cultivate your virtue alone.”

sentences.zh: 」諳班勃極烈者，太宗嘗居是官，及登大位，以命弟杲。

translations.literal: As for an-ban boji lie: Taizong had once held that office, and when he ascended the throne he conferred it on his younger brother Gao.
translations.idiomatic: The an-ban boji lie was the post Taizong himself had once held; on taking the throne he gave it to his brother Gao.

sentences.zh: 杲薨，帝定議爲儲嗣，故以是命焉。

translations.literal: When Gao died, the Emperor fixed on him as heir, and so made this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: After Gao’s death Taizong chose him as successor, and this appointment followed.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，左副元帥宗輔薨。

translations.literal: On jiashen in the fifth month, Left Deputy Commander-in-Chief Zongfu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the fifth month the left deputy commander-in-chief Zongfu died.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，追尊皇考豐王爲景宣皇帝，廟號徽宗，皇妣蒲察氏爲惠昭皇后。

translations.literal: On renshen in the ninth month, the late father Prince Feng was posthumously honored as Emperor Jingxuan with temple name Huizong, and the late mother Lady Pucha as Empress Huizhao.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the ninth month his late father, Prince Feng, was raised posthumously to Emperor Jingxuan (temple name Huizong), and his late mother, Lady Pucha, to Empress Huizhao.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，尊太祖后紇石烈氏、太宗后唐括氏皆爲太皇太后，詔中外。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Empresses Dowager of Taizu (He-shilie) and Taizong (Tangguo) were both honored as Grand Empress Dowagers, with an edict to court and country.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the widows of Taizu (He-shilie) and Taizong (Tangguo) were both elevated to grand empress dowager, and the decree was proclaimed within and without.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，改葬徽宗及惠昭后爲興陵。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Emperor Huizong and Empress Huizhao were reinterred at Xingling.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Emperor Huizong and Empress Huizhao were moved to Xingling.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以尚書令宋國王宗磐爲太師。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Chief Minister of the Department of State Affairs and Prince of Song Zongpan was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zongpan, prince of Song and chief minister of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，初頒曆。

translations.literal: On yihai, the calendar was first promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the calendar was issued for the first time.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以元帥左監完顏希尹爲尚書左丞相兼侍中，太子少保高慶裔爲左丞，平陽尹蕭慶爲右丞。

translations.literal: On jimao, Army Supervisor on the Left Wanyan Xiyin was made Left Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrently Palace Attendant; Crown Prince Junior Mentor Gao Qingyi was made Left Vice Director; Pingyang Intendant Xiao Qing was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Wanyan Xiyin, left army supervisor, became left director of the Department of State Affairs and palace attendant; Gao Qingyi, junior mentor to the crown prince, became left vice director; and Xiao Qing, intendant of Pingyang, became right vice director.

sentences.zh: 己丑，建天開殿爲爻剌。

translations.literal: On jichou, the Tian Kai Hall was established as Yaola.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the Tian Kai Hall was set up as the Yaola residence.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，始定齊、高麗、夏朝賀、賜宴、朝辭儀。

translations.literal: On guihai in the twelfth month, rites for congratulatory audiences, banquets, and farewell audiences from Qi, Goryeo, and Xia were first fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the twelfth month the forms for congratulatory audiences, banquets, and farewell audiences from Qi, Goryeo, and Western Xia were established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 以京西鹿囿賜農民。

translations.literal: The western capital game preserve was granted to farming households.
translations.idiomatic: The game preserve west of the capital was given over to farmer cultivation.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月己巳朔，上朝太皇太后于兩宮。

translations.literal: On jisi, first day of the first month of the fourteenth year, the Emperor attended court before the Grand Empress Dowagers at both palaces.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, New Year’s Day of the first month in the fourteenth year, the emperor paid court to the grand empress dowagers in both palaces.

sentences.zh: 齊、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Qi, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，頒曆爲高麗。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the calendar was promulgated for Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the calendar was issued to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太皇太后紇石烈氏崩。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Grand Empress Dowager He-shilie died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Grand Empress Dowager He-shilie died.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，萬壽節，齊、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Longevity Festival, Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the Longevity Festival, Qi, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 上本七月七日生，以同皇考忌日，改用正月十七日。

translations.literal: The Emperor was natively born on the seventh day of the seventh month; because it coincided with his late father’s death anniversary, he changed it to the seventeenth day of the first month.
translations.idiomatic: He had been born on the seventh day of the seventh month, but because that day fell on his late father’s death anniversary he moved the celebration to the seventeenth of the first month.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，上尊諡曰欽憲皇后，葬睿陵。

translations.literal: On guimao in the second month, posthumous title Qinxian Empress was bestowed, and burial at Ruiling.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the second month she was given the posthumous title Empress Qinxian and buried at Ruiling.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，乙太保宗翰、太師宗磐、太傅宗幹並領三省事。

translations.literal: On renyang in the third month, Grand Guardian Zonghan, Grand Preceptor Zongpan, and Grand Tutor Zonggan all took charge of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On renyang in the third month Grand Guardian Zonghan, Grand Preceptor Zongpan, and Grand Tutor Zonggan jointly headed the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，高麗遣使來吊。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Goryeo sent envoys to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Goryeo sent envoys to mourn.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，追尊九代祖以下曰皇帝、皇后，定始祖、景祖、世祖、太祖、太宗廟皆不祧。

translations.literal: On bingchen in the eighth month, ancestors from the ninth generation upward were posthumously honored as emperors and empresses; temples of the First Ancestor, Jingzu, Shizu, Taizu, and Taizong were all fixed as never to be displaced.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the eighth month forebears from the ninth generation back were raised to emperor and empress; the shrines of the First Ancestor, Jingzu, Shizu, Taizu, and Taizong were all declared perpetual and not to be removed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔齊國與本朝軍民訴訟相關者，文移署年，止用天會。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict: lawsuits between Jin military and civilians and those of the Qi state that were mutually related, in written documents dated by reign year, should use only Tianhui.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict ruled that when Jin soldiers or civilians and subjects of Qi brought suits against one another, official papers should be dated only in the Tianhui reign.

sentences.zh: 十月甲寅，以吳激爲高麗王生日使，蕭仲恭爲齊劉豫回謝並生日正旦使。

translations.literal: On jiayin in the tenth month, Wu Ji was made envoy for the Goryeo king’s birthday; Xiao Zhonggong was made envoy to return thanks to Liu Yu of Qi and for New Year’s Day of the orthodox calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the tenth month Wu Ji was sent as envoy for the Goryeo king’s birthday, and Xiao Zhonggong as envoy to return Liu Yu’s thanks to Qi and to observe New Year’s Day.

sentences.zh: 天眷元年正月戊子朔，上朝明德宮。

translations.literal: First year of Tianjuan, on wuzi, first day of the first month, the Emperor attended court at Mingde Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianjuan, on wuzi, New Year’s Day, the emperor held court at Mingde Palace.

sentences.zh: 高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo and Western Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 頒女直小字。

translations.literal: The Jurchen small script was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen small script was issued.

sentences.zh: 封大司空昱爲王。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Works Yu was enfeoffed as prince.
translations.idiomatic: Yu, grand minister of works, was enfeoffed as a prince.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，萬壽節，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Longevity Festival, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the Longevity Festival, Goryeo and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，上如爻剌春水。

translations.literal: On renxu in the second month, the Emperor went to the Yaola spring hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the second month the emperor went to the Yaola spring camp.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，幸天開殿。

translations.literal: On yichou, he visited the Tian Kai Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he visited the Tian Kai Hall.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔罷來流水、混同江護邏地，與民耕牧。

translations.literal: On jisi, an edict abolished the protective patrol zones along the Laishui and Huntong rivers and opened the land for farming and grazing.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi an edict ended patrol restrictions along the Laishui and Huntong rivers and opened the ground to plowing and pasture.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，以禁苑隙地分給百姓。

translations.literal: On gengyin in the third month, spare land in the imperial park was distributed to commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the third month unused ground in the imperial park was parceled out to the people.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以韓昉爲翰林學士。

translations.literal: On wushen, Han Fang was made Academician of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Han Fang was appointed Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 四月丁卯，命少府監盧彥倫營建宮室，止從儉素。

translations.literal: On dingmao in the fourth month, the Junior Director of the Palace Storehouse Lu Yanlun was ordered to construct palace buildings, keeping to frugality and simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the fourth month Lu Yanlun, junior director of the palace storehouse, was charged to build the palaces on a spare and simple scale.

sentences.zh: 壬午，朝享爲天元殿。

translations.literal: On renyang, morning audience was held at the Tianyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renyang the morning audience was held in the Tianyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 立裴滿氏爲貴妃。

translations.literal: Lady Peiman was established as Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Peiman was installed as noble consort.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，詔以經義、詞賦兩科取士。

translations.literal: On jihai in the fifth month, an edict ordered recruitment by examination in two fields: Classics and rhapsody-composition.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the fifth month an edict opened examinations in two subjects—classics and fu rhapsody—to select officials.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，上至自天開殿。

translations.literal: On wuwu in the sixth month, the Emperor returned from the Tian Kai Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the sixth month the emperor returned from the Tian Kai Hall.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，左副元帥撻懶、東京留守宗雋來朝。

translations.literal: On xinmao in the seventh month, Left Deputy Commander-in-Chief Tatlan and Eastern Capital defender Zongjun came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the seventh month Tatlan, left deputy commander-in-chief, and Zongjun, defender of the Eastern Capital, arrived at court.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，按出滸河溢，壞廬舍，民多溺死。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Chushui River overflowed, destroying houses; many people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the Chushui burst its banks, wrecking dwellings and drowning many.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，左丞相希尹罷。

translations.literal: On renyin, Left Chief Councillor Xiyin was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the left chief councillor Xiyin was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅朔，頒行官制。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiayin, the new-moon day, the official ranks system was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiayin, the new moon, the court issued its system of official ranks.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，回鶻遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On guihai, the Uyghurs sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Uyghurs sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以河南地與宋。

translations.literal: On jimao, the Henan territory was granted to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Henan territories were ceded to Song.

sentences.zh: 以右司侍郎張通古等使江南。

translations.literal: Zhang Tonggu, right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and others were sent as envoys to Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tonggu of the Department of State Affairs and others were dispatched as envoys to Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 以京師爲上京，府曰會寧，舊上京爲北京。

translations.literal: The capital was made the Upper Capital; the prefecture was called Huining; the former Upper Capital became the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The seat of government was declared the Upper Capital, its prefecture named Huining, while the old Upper Capital was redesignated the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申朔，以奭爲會甯牧，封鄧王。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the new-moon day of the ninth month, Shi was made superintendent of Huining and enfeoffed as Prince of Deng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the ninth month’s new moon, Shi was appointed superintendent of Huining and enfeoffed as prince of Deng.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔百官誥命，女直、契丹、漢人各用本字，渤海同漢人。

translations.literal: On yimao, an edict ordered that commission documents for officials—Jurchen, Khitan, and Han—each use their native script; Bohai the same as Han.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao an edict ruled that official commissions be written in each man’s own script—Jurchen, Khitan, or Chinese—with Bohai treated like Chinese.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，改燕京樞密院爲行台尚書省。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Yanjing Military Affairs Commission was changed to the Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the Yanjing Military Affairs Commission was converted into a Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上朝明德宮。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the Emperor held court at Mingde Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the emperor held court at Mingde Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以奕爲平章政事。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Yi was made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Yi was appointed grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 己酉，省燕中西三京、平州東、西等路州縣。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the prefectures and counties of the three western capitals in Yan and the eastern and western routes of Pingzhou were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the court abolished prefectures and counties in Yan’s three western capitals and along Pingzhou’s eastern and western circuits.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，權行台左丞相張孝純致仕。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Zhang Xiaochun, acting left chief councillor of the Branch Secretariat, retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Zhang Xiaochun, acting left chief councillor of the Branch Secretariat, retired.

sentences.zh: 十月甲寅朔，以御前管勾契丹文字李德固爲參知政事。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the new-moon day of the tenth month, Li Degu, keeper of Khitan script before the throne, was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the tenth month’s new moon, Li Degu, who managed Khitan script in the imperial presence, became vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，封叔宗強爲紀王，宗敏邢王，太宗子斛魯補等十三人爲王。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the uncle Zongqiang was enfeoffed as Prince of Ji, Zongmin as Prince of Xing, and thirteen of Taizong’s sons including Hulubu were made princes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Uncle Zongqiang was made prince of Ji and Zongmin prince of Xing; thirteen of Taizong’s sons, among them Hulubu, received princely titles.

sentences.zh: 己巳，始禁親王以下佩刀入宮。

translations.literal: On jisi, princes and those below were first forbidden to wear swords when entering the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the court first barred princes and lower ranks from wearing swords inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛未，定封國制。

translations.literal: On xinwei, regulations on enfeoffed states were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the statutes governing princely domains were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以東京留守宗雋爲尚書左丞相兼侍中，封陳王。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Zongjun, defender of the Eastern Capital, was made Left Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrently Palace Attendant, and enfeoffed as Prince of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Zongjun, defender of the Eastern Capital, became left director of the Department of State Affairs and palace attendant and was enfeoffed as prince of Chen.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，以康宗以上畫像工畢，奠獻爲乾元殿。

translations.literal: On bingchen in the eleventh month, when the painted portraits from Kangzong upward were finished, offerings were presented at Qianyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the eleventh month, once the portraits from Kangzong and his forebears were complete, they were installed with offerings in Qianyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，新宮成。

translations.literal: On guihai in the twelfth month, the new palace was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the twelfth month the new palace was finished.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，高麗遣使入貢。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Goryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，立貴妃裴滿氏爲皇后。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Noble Consort Peiman was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Lady Peiman, noble consort, was raised to empress.

sentences.zh: 二年正月壬午朔，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On renchen, the new-moon day of the first month in the second year, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, New Year’s Day of the second year, Goryeo and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，萬壽節，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the Longevity Festival, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the Longevity Festival, Goryeo and Western Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 以左丞相宗雋爲太保、領三省事，進封袞國王。

translations.literal: Zongjun, left chief councillor, was made Grand Guardian and put in charge of the Three Departments, and advanced in enfeoffment to Prince of the Gun State.
translations.idiomatic: Zongjun, the left chief councillor, was made grand guardian, placed over the Three Departments, and advanced to prince of the Gun state.

sentences.zh: 興中尹完顏希尹復爲尚書左丞相兼侍中。

translations.literal: Wanyan Xiyin, intendant of Xingzhong, was again made Left Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrently Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Xiyin, intendant of Xingzhong, was restored as left director of the Department of State Affairs and palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，上如天開殿。

translations.literal: On yimao in the second month, the Emperor went to the Tian Kai Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the second month the emperor went to the Tian Kai Hall.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，命百官詳定儀制。

translations.literal: On bingchen in the third month, officials were ordered to work out ritual regulations in detail.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the third month the court ordered officials to draft the ritual code in full.

sentences.zh: 四月甲戌，百官朝參，初用朝服。

translations.literal: On jiaxu in the fourth month, officials attended court audience and for the first time used court robes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the fourth month the bureaucracy attended audience in court dress for the first time.

sentences.zh: 己卯，宋遣使謝河南地。

translations.literal: On jimao, Song sent envoys to give thanks for the Henan territory.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Song dispatched envoys to thank the court for Henan.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On wuzi in the fifth month, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the fifth month Venus appeared in daylight—an omen.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上至自天開殿。

translations.literal: On yisi, the Emperor returned from the Tian Kai Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the emperor returned from the Tian Kai Hall.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉朔，初御冠服。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the new-moon day of the sixth month, he for the first time wore the cap and robes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the sixth month’s new moon, he first assumed formal cap and robes.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，吳十謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Wu Shi plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Wu Shi rose in rebellion and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 己未，上從容謂侍臣曰：「朕每閱《貞觀政要》，見其君臣議論，大可規法。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the Emperor said at ease to his attendants: “Whenever I read the Essentials of Government from the Zhenguan Reign, I see how ruler and ministers debated—much there is worth taking as a model.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the emperor spoke easily to his attendants: “Whenever I read the Essentials of Government from the Zhenguan reign, I find the exchanges between ruler and ministers full of lessons worth following.

sentences.zh: 」翰林學士韓昉對曰：「皆由太宗溫顏訪問，房、杜輩竭忠盡誠。

translations.literal: ”Han Fang, Academician of the Hanlin Academy, replied: “It was all because Taizong questioned with a gentle countenance, and Fang and Du gave their utmost loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: ”Han Fang of the Hanlin Academy answered: “That was because Taizong questioned them with a gentle face, and Fang Xuanling and Du Rumi poured out loyal counsel.

sentences.zh: 其書雖簡，足以爲法。

translations.literal: The book, though brief, suffices as a model.
translations.idiomatic: The book is short, yet it is model enough.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「太宗固一代賢君，明皇何如？

translations.literal: ”The Emperor said: “Taizong was truly a sage ruler of his age—how does Ming Huang compare?
translations.idiomatic: ”The emperor said: “Taizong was a sage of his generation—what of Ming Huang?

sentences.zh: 」昉曰：「唐自太宗以來，惟明皇、憲宗可數。

translations.literal: ”Fang said: “From Taizong onward in Tang, only Ming Huang and Xianzong can be counted.
translations.idiomatic: ”Fang said: “After Taizong, only Ming Huang and Xianzong in Tang deserve to be named.

sentences.zh: 明皇所謂有始而無終者。

translations.literal: Ming Huang is what they call one who had a beginning but no end.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Huang is the ruler they say began well and ended badly.

sentences.zh: 初以艱危得位，用姚崇、宋璟，惟正是行，故能成開元之治。

translations.literal: At first he gained the throne amid hardship; employing Yao Chong and Song Jing, he pursued only what was right, and so achieved the Kaiyuan order.
translations.idiomatic: He took the throne in peril, put Yao Chong and Song Jing in office, and held to the straight path—thus the Kaiyuan order was achieved.

sentences.zh: 末年怠于萬機，委政李林甫，奸諛是用，以致天寶之亂。

translations.literal: In his later years he grew slack in the myriad affairs of state, entrusted government to Li Linfu, and employed flattery and sycophancy, bringing on the Tianbao rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In old age he tired of government, handed affairs to Li Linfu, and let flatterers rule—until the Tianbao rebellion broke out.

sentences.zh: 苟能慎終如始，則貞觀之風不難追矣。

translations.literal: Had he been as careful at the end as at the start, the style of Zhenguan would not have been hard to recover.
translations.idiomatic: Had he guarded the end as he did the beginning, the spirit of Zhenguan would not have been hard to win back.

sentences.zh: 」上稱善。

translations.literal: ”The Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: ”The emperor said that was well put.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「周成王何如主？

translations.literal: He also said: “What sort of ruler was King Cheng of Zhou?
translations.idiomatic: He went on: “What kind of sovereign was King Cheng of Zhou?

sentences.zh: 」昉對曰：「古之賢君。

translations.literal: ”Fang replied: “A sage ruler of antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: ”Fang answered: “A sage of the ancients.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「成王雖賢，亦周公輔佐之力。

translations.literal: ”The Emperor said: “Though King Cheng was sage, it was also the Duke of Zhou’s assisting strength.
translations.idiomatic: ”The emperor said: “King Cheng was wise, but it was the Duke of Zhou who made him so.

sentences.zh: 後世疑周公殺其兄，以朕觀之，爲社稷大計，亦不當非也。」

translations.literal: Later generations suspect the Duke of Zhou killed his elder brother; in my view, for the great plan of the altars of soil and grain, that should not be condemned either.”
translations.idiomatic: Later ages suspect the Duke of Zhou murdered his brother; as I see it, for the sake of the realm such an act ought not be condemned.”

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳，宋國王宗磐、袞國王宗雋謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On xinsi in the seventh month, Zongpan, Prince of Song, and Zongjun, Prince of the Gun State, plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the seventh month Zongpan, prince of Song, and Zongjun, prince of the Gun state, conspired in rebellion and were executed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以右副元帥宗弼爲都元帥，進封國王。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Right Deputy Commander-in-Chief Zongbi was made Commander-in-Chief and advanced in enfeoffment to prince.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the right deputy commander-in-chief Zongbi was named commander-in-chief and raised to princely rank.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以誅宗磐等詔中外。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict to all within and without announced the execution of Zongpan and the others.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai an edict to the empire proclaimed the punishment of Zongpan and his fellow conspirators.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以左副元帥撻懶爲台左丞相，杜充爲行台右丞相，蕭寶、耶律輝行台平章政事。

translations.literal: On jichou, Left Deputy Commander-in-Chief Tatlan was made left chief councillor of the Branch Secretariat, Du Chong was made right chief councillor of the Mobile Branch Secretariat, and Xiao Bao and Yelu Hui were made mobile branch grand councilors of the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Tatlan, left deputy commander-in-chief, became left chief councillor of the Branch Secretariat; Du Chong became right chief councillor of the Mobile Branch Secretariat; and Xiao Bao and Yelu Hui became mobile-branch vice grand councilors.

sentences.zh: 甲午，鹹州祥穩沂王暈坐與宗磐謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Xianzhou xiangwen Prince Yi of Yin, Hun, was executed for plotting rebellion with Zongpan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Prince Hun of Yin, xiangwen of Xianzhou, was put to death for conspiring with Zongpan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，乙太傅、領三省事宗幹爲太師，領三省如故，進封梁宋國王。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Grand Preceptor Zonggan, who headed the Three Departments, was made Grand Master, continued to head the Three Departments as before, and advanced in enfeoffment to Prince of the Liang-Song State.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Zonggan, grand preceptor and head of the Three Departments, was raised to grand master, kept charge of the Three Departments, and advanced to prince of the Liang-Song state.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，行台左相撻懶、翼王鶻懶及活離胡土、撻懶子斡帶、烏達補謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinhai, Mobile Branch left chief councillor Tatlan, Wing Prince Huhen, Huoli Hutu, Tatlan’s son Wodai, and Udabu plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinhai, Tatlan as mobile-branch left chief councillor, Wing Prince Huhen, Huoli Hutu, Tatlan’s son Wodai, and Udabu rose in rebellion and were executed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Venus appeared in daylight—an omen.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，詔元帥府復取河南、陝西地。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingzi, an edict ordered the Marshalate to recover the Henan and Shaanxi territories.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingzi, an edict commanded the marshalate to retake Henan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔冊李仁孝爲夏國王。

translations.literal: On jimao, an edict enfeoffed Li Renxiao as king of Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao an edict invested Li Renxiao as king of Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 命都元帥宗弼以兵自黎陽趨汴，右監軍撒離合出河中趨陝西。

translations.literal: The Commander-in-Chief Zongbi was ordered to lead troops from Liyang toward Bian, and Right Army Supervisor Salihé to march from Hezhong toward Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Zongbi was ordered to advance from Liyang on Bian, while right army supervisor Salihé was to move from Hezhong into Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，河南平。

translations.literal: That month, Henan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month Henan was brought under control.

sentences.zh: 六月，陝西平。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Shaanxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Shaanxi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 上次涼陘大旱。

translations.literal: When the Emperor went up to Liang Pass, a severe drought struck.
translations.idiomatic: While the emperor was at Liang Pass a severe drought set in.

sentences.zh: 使蕭彥讓、田鐧決西京囚。

translations.literal: He sent Xiao Yanrang and Tian Jian to decide cases among prisoners in the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Xiao Yanrang and Tian Jian to review prisoners in the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on guimao, new-moon day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on guimao, the seventh month’s new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，宗弼遣使奏河南、陝西捷。

translations.literal: On yimao, Zongbi sent envoys to report victory in Henan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zongbi dispatched envoys announcing victory in Henan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔文武官五品以上致仕，給俸祿之半，職三品者仍給傔人。

translations.literal: On dingmao, an edict ruled that civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above who retired were to receive half salary; those whose former office had been third rank or higher still received attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao an edict granted retired civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above half pay, and those who had held third rank or higher still received household staff.

sentences.zh: 皇統元年正月辛丑朔，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: First year of Huangtong, first month, on xinchou, new-moon day, Goryeo and Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangtong, on xinchou, New Year’s Day, Goryeo and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，群臣上尊號曰崇天體道欽明文武聖德皇帝。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the officials presented an honorific title: Emperor Revering Heaven, Embodying the Way, Respectful and Illustrious in Civil and Military Sage Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the court offered the honorific “Emperor Revering Heaven, Embodying the Way, Respectful and Illustrious in Civil and Military Sage Virtue.”

sentences.zh: 初御袞冕。

translations.literal: For the first time he assumed the imperial robes and cap.
translations.idiomatic: For the first time he wore the full imperial regalia.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，謝太廟。

translations.literal: On guichou, he offered thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he performed a thanksgiving rite at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: The court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 改元。

translations.literal: The reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: The reign era was changed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，萬壽節，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Longevity Festival, Goryeo and Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the Longevity Festival, Goryeo and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 己未，初定命婦封號。

translations.literal: On jiwei, titles for ennobled consorts were first fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the ranks for ennobled consorts were established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 夏國請置榷場，許之。

translations.literal: Western Xia requested a government monopoly market; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Western Xia asked to open a border market; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，封平章政事昂爲漆水郡王。

translations.literal: On jisi, Grand Councilor Ang was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Grand Councilor Ang was enfeoffed as prince of Qishui commandery.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，詔諸致仕官職俱至三品者，俸祿人力各給其半。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuyin, an edict ruled that all retired officials whose former office had reached third rank were to receive half salary and half household staff.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuyin, an edict granted retired officials who had held third rank half pay and half their former household staff.

sentences.zh: 宗弼克廬州。

translations.literal: Zongbi captured Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zongbi took Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，改封海濱王耶律延禧爲豫王，昏德公趙佶爲天水郡王，重昏侯趙桓爲天水郡公。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the Coastal King Yelu Yanxi was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Yu, the Deposed Duke Zhao Ji as Duke of the Tianwater Commandery, and the Twice-Deposed Marquis Zhao Huan as Duke of the Tianwater District.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Coastal King Yelu Yanxi was redesignated prince of Yu, Deposed Duke Zhao Ji became duke of Tianwater commandery, and Twice-Deposed Marquis Zhao Huan became duke of Tianwater district.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上親祭孔子廟，北面再拜。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the Temple of Confucius and bowed twice facing north.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the emperor sacrificed at the Temple of Confucius and bowed twice toward the north.

sentences.zh: 退謂侍臣曰：「朕幼年遊佚，不知志學，歲月逾邁，深以爲悔。

translations.literal: On retiring he said to his attendants: “In youth I roamed in idleness and did not know the resolve to study; the years have slipped past, and I deeply regret it.
translations.idiomatic: Leaving the temple he told his attendants: “In youth I wasted my days and never fixed my mind on learning. The years have run on, and I regret it deeply.

sentences.zh: 孔子雖無位，其道可尊，使萬世景仰。

translations.literal: Though Confucius held no throne, his Way can be honored and made the object of ten thousand generations’ reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius never held a throne, yet his Way deserves honor—something for ten thousand generations to look up to.

sentences.zh: 大凡爲善，不可不勉。

translations.literal: In general, whenever one does good, one must not fail to strive.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever good you mean to do, you must press on and do it.

sentences.zh: 」自是頗讀《尚書》、《論語》及《五代》、《遼史》諸書，或以夜繼焉。

translations.literal: ”From then on he read rather widely in the Documents, Analects, and books such as the Histories of the Five Dynasties and Liao, sometimes continuing into the night.
translations.idiomatic: ”After that he read widely in the Documents, the Analects, and histories such as those of the Five Dynasties and the Liao, often far into the night.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，上至自燕京。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wushen, the Emperor returned from Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wushen, the emperor returned from Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 朝太皇太后于明德宮。

translations.literal: He attended court before the Grand Empress Dowager at Mingde Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He paid court to the grand empress dowager at Mingde Palace.

sentences.zh: 詔賜鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，人絹二匹、絮三斤。

translations.literal: An edict granted to widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves two bolts of silk and three jin of cotton wadding per person.
translations.idiomatic: An edict gave two bolts of silk and three jin of cotton wadding apiece to widowers, widows, orphans, and others unable to support themselves.

sentences.zh: 是秋，蝗。

translations.literal: That autumn there was a locust plague.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn locusts ravaged the land.

sentences.zh: 都元帥宗弼伐宋，渡淮。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Zongbi campaigned against Song and crossed the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Zongbi marched against Song and crossed the Huai.

sentences.zh: 以書讓宋，宋復書乞罷兵，宗弼以便宜畫淮爲界。

translations.literal: He sent a letter reproaching Song; Song replied begging to cease hostilities, and Zongbi on his own authority drew the Huai as the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote to rebuke Song; Song answered pleading for peace, and Zongbi on his own authority fixed the Huai as the border.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，高麗國賀受尊號。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiyou, Goryeo congratulated him on receiving the honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiyou, Goryeo sent envoys to congratulate him on his new honorific.

sentences.zh: 稽古殿火。

translations.literal: The Scrutinizing Antiquity Hall burned.
translations.idiomatic: Fire destroyed the Scrutinizing Antiquity Hall.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，夏國賀受尊號。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guisi, Western Xia congratulated him on receiving the honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guisi, Western Xia sent congratulations on his new honorific.

sentences.zh: 天水郡公趙桓乞本品俸，詔賙濟之。

translations.literal: Duke of the Tianwater District Zhao Huan begged salary at his former rank; an edict ordered relief granted.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Tianwater district Zhao Huan petitioned for pay at his former rank; the court ordered him supported.

sentences.zh: 左丞勖進先朝《實錄》三卷，上焚香立受之。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Xu presented three fascicles of the Veritable Records of the previous reign; the Emperor burned incense and received them standing.
translations.idiomatic: Left vice director Xu presented three fascicles of the previous reign’s Veritable Records; the emperor burned incense and received them standing.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，還自天開殿。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinchou, he returned from the Tian Kai Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinchou, he returned from the Tian Kai Hall.

sentences.zh: 大雪。

translations.literal: Heavy snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以宗弼爲太傅。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Zongbi was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Zongbi was appointed grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，遣左宣徽使劉筈以袞冕圭冊冊宋康王爲帝。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Left Palace Commissioner Liu Ke was sent with the imperial robes, cap, and jade regalia to invest the Prince of Kang of Song as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Left Palace Commissioner Liu Ke was dispatched with imperial robes, cap, and jade regalia to invest the Prince of Kang of Song as emperor.

sentences.zh: 歸宋帝母韋氏及故妻邢氏、天水郡王並妻鄭氏喪爲江南。

translations.literal: The mother of the former Song emperor, Lady Wei, and the former consort Lady Xing, the Duke of Tianwater Commandery and Lady Zheng, and the latter’s coffin were sent south to Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: The former Song empress dowager Lady Wei, the former consort Lady Xing, Duke of Tianwater commandery Zhao Ji and Lady Zheng, and the duke’s coffin were escorted south to Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，立子濟安爲皇太子。

translations.literal: On wuwu, his son Ji’an was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu his son Ji’an was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 四月丙寅，以臣宋告中外。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on bingyin, he announced to all within and without that he had become a vassal of Song.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the fourth month an edict proclaimed vassalage to Song within and without the realm.

sentences.zh: 庚午，五雲樓、重明等殿成。

translations.literal: On gengwu the Five Clouds Tower, Bright Repose, and other halls were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the Five Clouds Tower, the Hall of Double Brightness, and other palace halls were finished.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳朔，不視朝。

translations.literal: On guisi, the new moon of the fifth month, he held no court audience.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the fifth month’s new moon, he did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 上自去年荒爲酒，與近臣飲，或繼以夜。

translations.literal: From last year the emperor had abandoned himself to wine, drinking with close ministers, sometimes through the night.
translations.idiomatic: Since the previous year the emperor had given himself over to drink, carousing with close ministers far into the night.

sentences.zh: 宰相入諫，輒飲以酒，曰：「知卿等意，今既飲矣，明日當戒。

translations.literal: When grand councilors came to remonstrate, he would ply them with wine, saying: “I know your intent; I have drunk now—tomorrow I shall reform.
translations.idiomatic: When grand councilors came to remonstrate, he would ply them with wine and say, “I know what you mean. I have drunk today; tomorrow I shall reform.

sentences.zh: 」因復飲。

translations.literal: ” Then he would drink again.
translations.idiomatic: ”—and then drink again.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜宋誓詔。

translations.literal: On yimao he bestowed on Song the oath edict.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the court sent Song the treaty oath edict.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，宴群臣于五雲樓，皆盡醉而罷。

translations.literal: On xinyou he banqueted the ministers at the Five Clouds Tower; all drank their fill before dispersing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he feasted the ministers in the Five Clouds Tower until every man was drunk.

sentences.zh: 七月甲午，回鶻遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On jiawu in the seventh month the Uyghurs sent tribute envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the seventh month the Uyghurs sent tributary envoys.

sentences.zh: 北京、廣寧府蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts struck Beijing and Guangning prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts infested Beijing and Guangning prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賜宗弼金券。

translations.literal: On dingyou Zongbi was given a gold tally voucher.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Zongbi received a golden tally of authority.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，詔歸硃弁、張邵、洪皓于宋。

translations.literal: On dingmao in the eighth month an edict ordered the release of Zhu Bian, Zhang Shao, and Hong Hao to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the eighth month an edict ordered Zhu Bian, Zhang Shao, and Hong Hao sent home to Song.

sentences.zh: 辛未，復太宗子胡盧爲王。

translations.literal: On xinwei Taizong’s son Hulu was restored to princely rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Taizong’s son Hulu was restored to princely status.

sentences.zh: 賑陝西。

translations.literal: Relief was extended in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted famine relief in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，詔給天水郡王子、侄、婿，天水郡公子俸給。

translations.literal: On renchen in the ninth month an edict provided stipends to sons, nephews, and sons-in-law of the Prince of Tianshui and to sons of the Duke of Tianshui.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the ninth month an edict granted stipends to the prince of Tianshui’s sons, nephews, and sons-in-law and to the duke of Tianshui’s sons.

sentences.zh: 三年正月己丑朔，以皇太子喪不御正殿，群臣詣便殿稱賀。

translations.literal: Third year, first month, jichou new moon: because of the crown prince’s mourning he did not hold court in the main hall; ministers came to the side hall to offer New Year congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, New Year’s Day of the third year, the crown prince’s death kept the emperor from the main hall; ministers offered New Year greetings at the side hall.

sentences.zh: 宋、高麗、夏使詣皇極殿遙賀。

translations.literal: Song, Goryeo, and Xia envoys congratulated from afar at the Hall of Supreme Pole.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia offered distant congratulations at the Hall of Supreme Pole.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，萬壽節，如正旦儀。

translations.literal: On yisi, the Longevity Festival, the rites were the same as for New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the Longevity Festival, ceremonies followed the New Year precedent.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，以尚書左丞勖爲平章政事，殿前都點檢宗憲尚書左丞。

translations.literal: On xinmao in the third month Xu was made Chief Councilor; Zongxian, supreme commander of the palace guard, became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the third month Xu was promoted to chief councilor and Zongxian, commander of the palace guard, was named left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太皇太后唐括氏崩。

translations.literal: On dingyou Grand Empress Dowager Tanggute died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Grand Empress Dowager of the Tanggute clan died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，封子道濟爲魏王。

translations.literal: On jiyou his son Daoji was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou his son Daoji was enfeoffed as prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳朔，京兆進瑞麥。

translations.literal: On dingsi, fifth month new moon, Jingzhao presented auspicious wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the fifth month’s new moon, Jingzhao presented stalks of auspicious wheat.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上致祭太皇太后。

translations.literal: On guihai the emperor performed rites for the Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the emperor offered sacrifices for the late grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲申，初立太廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On jiashen the spirit temples and altars of soil and grain were first established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the court first established the imperial ancestral temple and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，初置驍毅軍。

translations.literal: On jiyou in the sixth month the Valiant Valor Army was first created.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the sixth month the court first established the Valiant Valor Army.

sentences.zh: 七月丙寅，上致祭太皇太后。

translations.literal: On bingyin in the seventh month the emperor again sacrificed for the Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the seventh month the emperor again sacrificed for the grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太原路進獬豸並瑞麥。

translations.literal: On gengchen Taiyuan circuit presented a xiezhi unicorn and auspicious wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Taiyuan circuit presented a xiezhi and stalks of auspicious wheat.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，詔給天水郡王孫及天水郡公婿俸祿。

translations.literal: On xinmao in the eighth month an edict granted stipends to grandsons of the Prince of Tianshui and sons-in-law of the Duke of Tianshui.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the eighth month an edict granted stipends to grandsons of the prince of Tianshui and sons-in-law of the duke of Tianshui.

sentences.zh: 丙申，老人星見。

translations.literal: On bingshen the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the Old Man star appeared—a portent of long life.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，諡太皇太后曰欽仁皇后。

translations.literal: On yisi the posthumous title Empress Qinren was given to the Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the late grand empress dowager was posthumously titled Qinren.

sentences.zh: 戊申，葬恭陵。

translations.literal: On wushen she was buried at Gongling.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen she was buried at Gongling.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On guiwei, twelfth month new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the twelfth month’s new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 四年正月癸丑朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Fourth year, guichou new moon: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, New Year’s Day of the fourth year, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔以去年宋幣賜始祖以下宗室。

translations.literal: On jiayin an edict distributed last year’s Song tribute silks among the imperial clan from the Founder down.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin an edict distributed last year’s Song tribute payments among the imperial clan from the Founder downward.

sentences.zh: 己未，以宋使王倫爲平州轉運使，既受命，復辭，罪其反覆，誅之。

translations.literal: On jiwei Song envoy Wang Lun was appointed transport commissioner of Pingzhou; having accepted, he then declined—the court condemned his vacillation and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Wang Lun, a Song envoy, was named transport commissioner of Pingzhou; after accepting the post he tried to decline—for his vacillation he was executed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，陝西進嘉禾十有二莖，莖皆七穗。

translations.literal: On yichou Shaanxi presented twelve stalks of auspicious grain, each with seven ears.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Shaanxi presented twelve stalks of auspicious grain, every stalk bearing seven ears.

sentences.zh: 己巳，萬壽節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On jisi, Longevity Festival, envoys came from Song, Goryeo, and Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Longevity Festival, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上祭欽仁皇后，哭盡哀。

translations.literal: On yihai the emperor sacrificed for Empress Qinren and wept to exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the emperor sacrificed for Empress Qinren and wept until grief was spent.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，上如東京。

translations.literal: On guiwei in the second month the emperor went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the second month the emperor went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 丙申，次百泊河春水。

translations.literal: On bingshen he halted at the spring hunt on the Baibo River.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he paused for the spring hunt on the Baibo River.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，回鶻遣使來賀，以粘合韓奴報之。

translations.literal: On dingyou Uyghur envoys came to congratulate; Nianhe Han’nu was sent to return the courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Uyghur envoys came with congratulations; Nianhe Han’nu was sent in reply.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥朔，次薰風殿。

translations.literal: On xinhai, fifth month new moon, he halted at the Hall of Fragrant Breeze.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the fifth month’s new moon, he encamped at the Hall of Fragrant Breeze.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On xinsi, sixth month new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the sixth month’s new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 五年正月丁未朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Fifth year, dingwei new moon: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, New Year’s Day of the fifth year, envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia came with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，萬壽節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On guihai, Longevity Festival, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the Longevity Festival, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，次濟州春水。

translations.literal: On yiwei in the second month he halted for the spring hunt at Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the second month he paused for the spring hunt at Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，次天開殿。

translations.literal: On wuchen in the third month he halted at the Tian Kai Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the third month he made camp at the Tian Kai Hall.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，初用御制小字。

translations.literal: On wuwu in the fifth month the emperor’s personal script in small characters was first used.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the fifth month the court first used the emperor’s personal Jurchen small script.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以平章政事勖諫，上爲止酒，仍佈告廷臣。

translations.literal: On renyin, because Chief Councilor Xu remonstrated, the emperor stopped drinking and announced this to the court.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, moved by Chief Councilor Xu’s remonstrance, the emperor gave up wine and proclaimed the fact to his ministers.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On yihai, sixth month new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the sixth month’s new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，發天開殿。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuxu, he set out from the Tian Kai Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuxu, the emperor departed the Tian Kai Hall.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，至自東京。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengshen, he returned from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengshen, he returned from the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 十月辛卯，增諡太祖。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on xinmao, Taizu’s posthumous title was augmented.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on xinmao, the court augmented Taizu’s posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊寅，大名府進牛生麟。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on wuyin, Daming prefecture presented an ox that bore a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on wuyin, Daming prefecture reported an ox that had calved a qilin.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，懷州進嘉禾。

translations.literal: On renchen, Huaizhou presented auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Huaizhou presented stalks of auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，增諡始祖以下十帝及太宗、徽宗。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wushen, posthumous titles were augmented for the ten emperors from the Founder downward and for Taizong and Huizong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wushen, the court augmented posthumous titles for the ten ancestral emperors from the Founder downward and for Taizong and Huizong.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，赦。

translations.literal: On dingsi, there was an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，以阿離補爲行台右丞相。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renshen, Ali Bu was made right grand councilor of the mobile secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renshen, Ali Bu was appointed right grand councilor of the mobile secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月庚子朔，上至自春水。

translations.literal: On gengzi, first day of the fourth month, the emperor returned from the spring hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the fourth month’s new moon, the emperor returned from the spring hunt.

sentences.zh: 以同判大宗正事宗固爲太保、右丞相兼中書令。

translations.literal: Associate director of the Imperial Clan Court Zonggu was made grand preceptor, right grand councilor, and concurrently director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Zonggu, associate director of the Imperial Clan Court, was promoted to grand preceptor, right grand councilor, and concurrent director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊午，行台右丞相阿離補薨。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Right Grand Councilor of the mobile secretariat Ali Bu died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Ali Bu, right grand councilor of the mobile secretariat, died.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，高麗王楷薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renshen, King Kojong of Goryeo died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renshen, King Kojong of Goryeo died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以左宣徽使劉筈爲行台右丞相。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Left Palace Commissioner Liu Ke was made right grand councilor of the mobile secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Left Palace Commissioner Liu Ke was named right grand councilor of the mobile secretariat.

sentences.zh: 七年正月乙丑朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Seventh year, first month, yichou new moon: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, New Year’s Day of the seventh year, envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia came with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，萬春節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the Longevity Festival, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the Longevity Festival, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以西京鹿囿爲民田。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the Western Capital’s deer park was turned into farmland for the people.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the deer park at the Western Capital was converted to civilian farmland.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太白經天。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Venus crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Venus crossed the sky—a celestial portent.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，高麗遣使謝弔祭、起復。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuyin, Goryeo sent envoys to thank the court for condolence sacrifices and for permission to leave mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuyin, Goryeo sent envoys to thank the court for condolence rites and for authorization to leave mourning.

sentences.zh: 四月戊午，宴便殿。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on wuwu, he banqueted in the side hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wuwu, the emperor feasted in the side hall.

sentences.zh: 上醉酒，殺戶部尚書宗禮。

translations.literal: The emperor, drunk with wine, killed Minister of Revenue Zongli.
translations.idiomatic: Drunk, the emperor killed Zongli, minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，殺橫海軍節度使田鐧、左司郎中奚毅、翰林待制邢具瞻及王植、高鳳廷、王效、趙益興、龔夷鑒等。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingyou, he killed Henghai Army military commissioner Tian Juan, Left Department director Xi Yi, Hanlin awaiting appointment Xing Juzhan, and Wang Zhi, Gao Fengting, Wang Xiao, Zhao Yixing, Gong Yijian, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingyou, he executed Henghai Army commissioner Tian Juan, Left Department director Xi Yi, Hanlin awaiting appointment Xing Juzhan, and Wang Zhi, Gao Fengting, Wang Xiao, Zhao Yixing, Gong Yijian, and others.

sentences.zh: 七月己巳，太白經天，曲赦畿內。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on jisi, Venus crossed the heavens; a partial amnesty was granted within the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jisi, Venus again crossed the sky and the court granted a partial amnesty in the capital region.

sentences.zh: 九月，太保、右丞相宗固薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Grand Preceptor and Right Grand Councilor Zonggu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Grand Preceptor and Right Grand Councilor Zonggu died.

sentences.zh: 以都元帥宗弼爲太師、領三省事，都元帥、行台尚書省事如故，平章政事勖爲左丞相兼侍中，都點檢宗賢爲右丞相兼中書令，行台右丞相劉筈、右丞蕭仲恭爲平章政事，李德固爲尚書右丞，秘書監蕭肄爲參知政事。

translations.literal: Supreme Commander Zongbi was made grand preceptor and directed the Three Departments; his posts as supreme commander and director of mobile secretariat affairs remained as before. Grand councilor Xu was made left chief councilor and concurrently palace attendant. Commander of the palace guard Zongxian was made right chief councilor and concurrently director of the Secretariat. Mobile secretariat right grand councilor Liu Ke and right vice director Xiao Zhonggong were made grand councilors. Li Degu was made right vice director of the Department of State Affairs. Secretariat director Xiao Zi was made vice grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Zongbi, supreme commander, was promoted to grand preceptor and put in charge of the Three Departments while retaining supreme command and direction of mobile secretariat affairs. Grand councilor Xu became left chief councilor and palace attendant. Palace guard commander Zongxian became right chief councilor and concurrent director of the Secretariat. Mobile secretariat right grand councilor Liu Ke and right vice director Xiao Zhonggong were named grand councilors; Li Degu became right vice director of the Department of State Affairs; and Secretariat director Xiao Zi became vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 十月壬子，平章行台尚書省事奚寶薨。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on renzi, Grand Councilor of mobile secretariat affairs Xi Bao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on renzi, Grand Councilor of mobile secretariat affairs Xi Bao died.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，以工部侍郎僕散太彎爲御史大夫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guiyou, Vice Minister of Works Pusan Taiwan was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiyou, Works vice minister Pusan Taiwan was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，兵部尚書秉德進三角羊。

translations.literal: On yihai, Minister of War Bingde presented a three-horned sheep.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Minister of War Bingde presented a sheep with three horns.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔減常膳羊豕五之二。

translations.literal: On jimao, an edict reduced the regular table’s sheep and swine by two-fifths.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao an edict cut the court’s daily provision of sheep and swine by two-fifths.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以尚書左丞宗憲爲行台平章政事，同判大宗正事亮爲尚書左丞。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Zongxian was made grand councilor of the mobile secretariat; Associate Director of the Imperial Clan Court Liang was made left vice director.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Zongxian, left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was named grand councilor of the mobile secretariat, and Imperial Clan associate director Liang was made left vice director.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，參知政事韓昉罷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuwu, Vice Grand Councilor Han Fang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuwu, Vice Grand Councilor Han Fang was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書秉德爲參知政事。

translations.literal: Minister of War Bingde was made vice grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Bingde was promoted to vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 八年正月庚申朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Eighth year, first month, gengshen new moon: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, New Year’s Day of the eighth year, envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia came with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 丙子，萬壽節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the Longevity Festival, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Longevity Festival, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，以哥魯葛波古等爲橫賜高麗、夏國使。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renzi, Goluge Bogu and others were sent as envoys bearing horizontal gifts to Goryeo and Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renzi, Goluge Bogu and others were dispatched as gift-bearing envoys to Goryeo and Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以大理卿宗安等爲高麗王晛封冊使。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Court of Judicial Review director Zong’an and others were sent as enfeoffment envoys to invest King Xian of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Zong’an of the Court of Judicial Review and others were sent to invest King Xian of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上如天開殿。

translations.literal: On yimao, the emperor went to the Tian Kai Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the emperor went to the Tian Kai Hall.

sentences.zh: 四月戊子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On wuzi, first day of the fourth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the fourth month’s new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣參知政事秉德等爲廉察官吏。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Vice Grand Councilor Bingde and others were sent to inspect officials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Vice Grand Councilor Bingde and others were dispatched on an integrity inspection of officials.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，至自天開殿。

translations.literal: On gengxu, he returned from the Tian Kai Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he returned from the Tian Kai Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，《遼史》成。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the History of Liao was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the compilation of the History of Liao was completed.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，平章政事蕭仲恭爲行台左丞相，左丞亮爲平章政事，都點檢唐括辯爲尚書左丞。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yimao, Grand Councilor Xiao Zhonggong was made left grand councilor of the mobile secretariat; Left Vice Director Liang was made grand councilor; Commander of the palace guard Tangguo Bian was made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yimao, Grand Councilor Xiao Zhonggong became left grand councilor of the mobile secretariat, Left Vice Director Liang became grand councilor, and palace guard commander Tangguo Bian became left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 高麗遣使謝封冊。

translations.literal: Goryeo sent envoys to thank the court for the investiture.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo sent envoys to thank the court for the investiture.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，太白經天。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen, Venus crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renchen, Venus again crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 乙未，左丞相宗賢、左丞稟等言，州郡長吏當並用本國人。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Left Chief Councilor Zongxian, Left Vice Director Bing, and others said that prefectural and circuit heads ought all to be men of our own country.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Left Chief Councilor Zongxian, Left Vice Director Bingde, and others urged that prefectural and circuit governors should all be Jurchens.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「四海之內，皆朕臣子，若分別待之，豈能致一。

translations.literal: The emperor said: “Within the four seas all are my subjects; if we treat them differently, how can we achieve unity?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, “Within the four seas all are my subjects. If we treat people differently, how can we achieve unity?

sentences.zh: 諺不雲乎，'疑人勿使，使人勿疑'。

translations.literal: Does not the proverb say, ‘Do not employ one you doubt; do not doubt one you employ’?
translations.idiomatic: Does not the proverb say, ‘Do not employ one you doubt; do not doubt one you employ’?

sentences.zh: 自今本國及諸色人，量才通用之。

translations.literal: From now on, whether native or of other stocks, appoint each according to talent.”
translations.idiomatic: From now on, whether Jurchen or of other stocks, appoint each according to talent alone.”

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，以尚書左丞相宗賢爲左副元帥，平章政事亮爲尚書左丞相兼侍中，參知政事秉德爲平章政事。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Left Chief Councilor Zongxian was made left vice commander-in-chief; Grand Councilor Liang was made left chief councilor and concurrently palace attendant; Vice Grand Councilor Bingde was made grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Zongxian was named left vice commander-in-chief; Grand Councilor Liang became left chief councilor and palace attendant; and Vice Grand Councilor Bingde became grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，左副元帥宗賢復爲太保，左丞相、左副元帥如故。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Left Vice Commander-in-Chief Zongxian was again made grand preceptor; his posts as left chief councilor and left vice commander-in-chief remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zongxian was again made grand preceptor while retaining the posts of left chief councilor and left vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，以右丞相蕭仲恭爲太傅、領三省事，左丞相亮爲尚書右丞相。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yimao, Right Chief Councilor Xiao Zhonggong was made grand tutor and directed the Three Departments; Left Chief Councilor Liang was made right chief councilor of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao, Right Chief Councilor Xiao Zhonggong was promoted to grand tutor and director of the Three Departments, and Left Chief Councilor Liang became right chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以左丞相宗賢爲太師、領三省事兼都元帥。

translations.literal: On yihai, Left Chief Councilor Zongxian was made grand preceptor, directed the Three Departments, and was concurrently supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zongxian was made grand preceptor, put in charge of the Three Departments, and named supreme commander as well.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，會甯牧唐括辯復爲尚書左丞，尚書左丞稟爲行台平章政事。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiayin, Director of the Metropolitan Herd Tangguo Bian was again made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs; Left Vice Director Bing was made grand councilor of the mobile secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiayin, Metropolitan Herd director Tangguo Bian was again made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and Left Vice Director Bingde became grand councilor of the mobile secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On guiwei, first day of the third month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the third month’s new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以司空宗本爲尚書右丞相兼中書令，左丞相亮爲太保、領三省事。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Minister of Works Zongben was made right chief councilor and concurrently director of the Secretariat; Left Chief Councilor Liang was made grand preceptor and directed the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Minister of Works Zongben became right chief councilor and concurrent director of the Secretariat, and Left Chief Councilor Liang was made grand preceptor directing the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 四月壬申夜，大風雨，雷電震壞寢殿鴟尾，有火入上寢，燒幃幔，帝趨別殿避之。

translations.literal: On the night of renshen in the fourth month, great wind and rain came; thunder and lightning shattered the owl-tail ornaments of the sleeping hall; fire entered the emperor’s chamber and burned the curtains; the emperor fled to another hall to escape.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renshen in the fourth month a violent storm broke; thunder shattered the owl-tail finials of the sleeping hall and fire swept into the imperial bedchamber, burning the curtains—the emperor fled to another hall.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，有龍鬥爲利州榆林河水上。

translations.literal: On dingchou, dragons were seen fighting on the Yulin River in Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou dragons were reported fighting on the Yulin River in Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 大風壞民居、官舍，瓦木人畜皆飄揚十數里，死傷者數百人。

translations.literal: Great wind destroyed commoners’ houses and government buildings; tiles, timbers, people, and livestock were all blown ten-odd li; those killed and injured numbered several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The gale wrecked private homes and government buildings alike; tiles, timbers, people, and livestock were hurled ten-odd li, and several hundred were killed or injured.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，以四月壬申、丁丑天變，肆赦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wuzi, because of the heaven-sent changes of renshen and dingchou in the fourth month, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuzi, the court proclaimed a general amnesty for the celestial portents of renshen and dingchou in the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 命翰林學士張鈞草詔，參知政事蕭肄擿其語以爲誹謗，上怒，殺鈞。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Zhang Jun was ordered to draft an amnesty edict; Vice Grand Councilor Xiao Zi picked out wording he called slanderous; the emperor was enraged and killed Zhang Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin academician Zhang Jun was ordered to draft the amnesty edict; Vice Grand Councilor Xiao Zi seized on a phrase as slander—the emperor flew into a rage and had Zhang Jun killed.

sentences.zh: 是日，曲赦上京囚。

translations.literal: That same day, a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners at the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the court granted a partial amnesty to prisoners at the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，出太保、領三省事亮領行台尚書省事。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Grand Preceptor Liang, who directed the Three Departments, was sent out to direct mobile secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Grand Preceptor Liang, director of the Three Departments, was assigned to head mobile secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊申，武庫署令耶律八斤妄稱上言宿直將軍蕭榮與胙王元爲黨，誅之。

translations.literal: On wushen, Armory director Yelü Bajin falsely reported that night-duty general Xiao Rong was in faction with Prince of Zuo Wang Yuan; they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Armory director Yelü Bajin falsely accused night-duty general Xiao Rong of faction with Prince of Zuo Yuan; both were put to death.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，以都元帥宗敏爲太保、領三省事兼左副元帥，左丞相宗賢兼都元帥。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiwei, Supreme Commander Zongmin was made grand preceptor, directed the Three Departments, and was concurrently left vice commander-in-chief; Left Chief Councilor Zongxian was concurrently supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiwei, Supreme Commander Zongmin became grand preceptor directing the Three Departments and left vice commander-in-chief, while Left Chief Councilor Zongxian was named concurrent supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，以劉筈爲司空，行台右丞相如故。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengshen, Liu Ke was made minister of works; his post as mobile secretariat right grand councilor remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengshen, Liu Ke was made minister of works while retaining the post of mobile secretariat right grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 宰臣議徙遼陽、勃海之民于燕南，從之。

translations.literal: The chief ministers discussed relocating the people of Liaoyang and Bohai to south of Yan; the emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers proposed relocating the people of Liaoyang and Bohai to the region south of Yan, and the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 侍從高壽星等當遷，訴爲后，后以白上，上怒議者，杖平章政事秉德，殺左司郎中三合。

translations.literal: Attendants Gao Shouxing and others were due for transfer and complained to the empress; the empress told the emperor; the emperor was enraged at those who had debated the matter, caned Grand Councilor Bingde, and killed Left Department director Sanhe.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants Gao Shouxing and others faced transfer and appealed to the empress, who reported it to the emperor. Enraged at the officials who had debated the policy, he had Grand Councilor Bingde beaten and Left Department director Sanhe executed.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，以領行台尚書省事亮復爲平章政事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingshen, Liang, who directed mobile secretariat affairs, was again made grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingshen, Liang, who had directed mobile secretariat affairs, was again made grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以右丞相宗本爲太保、領三省事，左副元帥宗敏領行台尚書省事，平章政事秉德爲尚書左丞相兼中書令，司空劉筈爲平章政事。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Right Chief Councilor Zongben was made grand preceptor and directed the Three Departments; Left Vice Commander-in-Chief Zongmin directed mobile secretariat affairs; Grand Councilor Bingde was made left chief councilor and concurrently director of the Secretariat; Minister of Works Liu Ke was made grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Right Chief Councilor Zongben became grand preceptor directing the Three Departments; Left Vice Commander-in-Chief Zongmin took charge of mobile secretariat affairs; Grand Councilor Bingde became left chief councilor and concurrent director of the Secretariat; and Minister of Works Liu Ke was named grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以御史大夫宗甫爲參知政事。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Censor-in-Chief Zongfu was made vice grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Censor-in-Chief Zongfu was promoted to vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 十月乙丑，殺北京留守胙王元及弟安武軍節度使查剌、左衛將軍特思。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on yichou, Prince of Zuo Yuan, garrison commander of the Northern Capital, and his younger brother Anwu Army military commissioner Chala and Left Guard general Tesi were killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yichou, Prince of Zuo Yuan, Northern Capital garrison commander, his younger brother Anwu Army commissioner Chala, and Left Guard general Tesi were executed.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: The court proclaimed a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以翰林學士京爲御史大夫。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Hanlin Academician Jing was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Hanlin academician Jing was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，殺皇后裴滿氏。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, Empress Peiman was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, Empress Peiman was put to death.

sentences.zh: 召胙王妃撒卯入宮。

translations.literal: The consort of Prince of Zuo,divorced consort Saomao, was summoned into the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Saomao, consort of the late Prince of Zuo, was summoned into the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，殺故鄧王子阿懶、達懶。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the former princes of Deng, A’lan and Da’lan, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the former princes of Deng, A’lan and Da’lan, were executed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上獵爲忽剌渾土溫。

translations.literal: On guisi, the emperor hunted at Hulahun Tuwun.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the emperor went hunting at Hulahun Tuwun.

sentences.zh: 遣使殺德妃烏古論氏及夾谷氏、張氏。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to kill Consort Wugulun and the Gu and Zhang consorts.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent agents to kill Consort Wugulun and the consorts of the Gu and Zhang clans.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉朔，上至自獵所。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiyou, first day, the emperor returned from the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the twelfth month’s new moon, the emperor returned from the hunt.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，殺妃裴滿氏爲寢殿。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Consort Peiman was used for the sleeping hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the emperor had the late Consort Peiman’s remains used in constructing a sleeping hall—a gesture of perverse cruelty.
